text: {"features":[{"evidence":"improvements there are inherited by every team downstream","name":"Role motivation","description":"This captures how clearly and compellingly the letter explains why this specific Google security-engineering role fits the applicant's priorities rather than just their general job search.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States interest in the job with little or no explanation of why this team or mission is specifically appealing."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows generic interest in security or backend work but gives only broad reasons that could fit many roles."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a clear role-specific reason such as foundational leverage, secure-by-default work, or security impact at scale."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects the role-specific reason to the applicant's own experience or values in a persuasive way."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Uses distinctive, well-developed framing that makes the applicant's motivation for this exact role feel unusually thoughtful and credible."}]},{"evidence":"defaults, not documents","name":"Automation insight","description":"This captures how well the letter shows understanding of the underlying problem of scaling security work through tooling, workflow design, and automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no clear view of how security work could be scaled through engineering."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions automation or secure defaults abstractly without explaining the mechanism or leverage."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explains at least one concrete way tooling can reduce manual security effort, such as triage automation or better defaults."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows sophisticated systems thinking about capacity, developer behavior, variant analysis, or bounded autonomous workflows."}]},{"evidence":"helping busy developer teams do the secure thing by default","name":"Enablement mindset","description":"This captures whether the applicant frames security tooling as something built for adoption by product engineers rather than as policing or after-the-fact review.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not discuss the needs or behavior of the developer teams who would use the tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions helping teams in general terms but without much user-centered thinking."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly emphasizes making secure behavior easy, routine, or default for busy engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly shows empathy for developer workflows, highlighting adoption, usability, proximity to users, or behavior-shaping design."}]},{"evidence":"Bachelor's ... Master's ... Doctoral degree in computer science","name":"Academic credential level","description":"This captures the level of formal postgraduate training the letter presents in a relevant technical field.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Bachelor's degree or equivalent only."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Master's degree in a relevant technical field."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Doctoral degree in a relevant technical field."}]},{"evidence":"3 years ... 5 years ... 7 years ... launched 2/4/6 services","name":"Production scope","description":"This captures the overall breadth of professional experience testing, maintaining, and launching software products in real production environments.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only minimal tenure or limited production launch history."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Meets the role baseline with several years of experience and some launched services."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a solid multi-year record across multiple services with clear maintenance and launch experience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows extensive production breadth, such as many years, many services, or a visible progression in responsibility."}]},{"evidence":"Go as my daily driver","name":"Go track record","description":"This captures the strength of direct Go experience in production backend work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go but does not make its role in shipped work clear."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows regular working use of Go that plausibly meets the role requirement."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a primary language across multiple production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial long-term Go ownership in building and operating backend systems."}]},{"evidence":"Python became my workhorse","name":"Python depth","description":"This captures how convincingly the letter shows production-grade Python usage beyond light scripting.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of Python use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows incidental or mostly scripting-level Python use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows substantial Python use for automation, tooling, prototypes, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production-grade Python work that other engineers rely on, often with maintainability or quality signals."}]},{"evidence":"Python agents ... Go services define permissions and audit their actions","name":"Agentic architecture","description":"This captures experience designing autonomous or semi-autonomous agent systems with explicit infrastructure and guardrails.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of agentic-system design."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI systems or automation without describing agent design."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agentic tooling with Python agents supported by backend services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains concrete autonomy controls such as permissions, contracts, auditing, supervision, or bounded execution."}]},{"evidence":"evaluation scaffolding required to deploy them responsibly","name":"Applied AI maturity","description":"This captures whether the applicant has shipped AI features and understands the reliability work needed to operate them responsibly.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no applied AI evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI or models only in general or aspirational terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows direct experience shipping model-backed or LLM-backed features in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows shipped AI work plus explicit attention to evaluation, hardening, failure modes, or trustworthiness."}]},{"evidence":"deduplicating findings and routing them to the owning teams","name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"This captures direct experience building tooling that automates the intake, triage, routing, or prioritization of vulnerability reports.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no vulnerability-handling workflow experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions vulnerability work but not ownership of the automation around it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building automation for a vulnerability intake or triage queue."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a richer pipeline with features such as classification, deduplication, routing, prioritization, or clear workload reduction."}]},{"evidence":"threat modeling and code review for common vulnerability classes","name":"Assessment depth","description":"This captures how much hands-on security assessment practice the letter shows, including method and follow-through.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no concrete security-assessment evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions reviews or assessments only briefly and without detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Names specific assessment activities such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface mapping, or service reviews."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a rigorous assessment practice with documentation, remediation validation, or a clear attacker or builder lens."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents security assessment as a mature engineering discipline applied across systems with clear methodology and follow-through."}]},{"evidence":"turned a brute-force correlation job into a streaming computation","name":"Data-structure fluency","description":"This captures whether the letter demonstrates practical algorithmic thinking through concrete redesigns or optimizations.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no concrete evidence of data-structure or algorithmic skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength but gives no real example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one specific example of improving a system through a better structure or algorithm."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a technically strong example that clearly changed system tractability, scalability, or performance."}]},{"evidence":"CompTIA Security+ ... OSCP","name":"Certification rigor","description":"This captures the strength of formal security credentials presented as external validation of security knowledge or hands-on skill.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Lists no relevant security certification."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Lists a baseline credential such as Security+."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Lists a hands-on credential such as OSCP."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Lists multiple relevant credentials spanning both foundational and hands-on security capability."}]},{"evidence":"near-top finishes in several major capture-the-flag events","name":"CTF engagement","description":"This captures whether the letter shows active offensive-security practice through capture-the-flag competition.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no capture-the-flag or similar competitive offensive practice."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional or casual participation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular and serious participation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong competitive results such as near-top finishes in substantial fields."}]},{"evidence":"maintainer of an actively used open-source project","name":"External stewardship","description":"This captures evidence of maintaining software for users beyond the applicant's immediate team, especially through open-source work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no evidence of externally facing code stewardship."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows limited external stewardship, such as occasional upstream patches or a small maintained public artifact."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows ongoing maintenance of a public project or library with real outside users."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear ownership of an actively used open-source project, including review, releases, community support, or roadmap work."}]},{"evidence":"built a distributed rate-limiting service with coordinated state across nodes","name":"Side-project ambition","description":"This captures how much technically substantial self-directed building the letter shows outside day-job responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no side-project evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a small personal utility or hobby project with limited technical scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a moderate standalone application or service with sustained follow-through."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows an ambitious self-directed system, especially infrastructure or distributed work with hard failure or consistency concerns."}]},{"evidence":"typed, tested services","name":"Evidence concreteness","description":"This captures how much the letter supports its claims with specific mechanisms, examples, or outcomes rather than broad assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on generic claims, requirement-matching language, or buzzwords."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mixes broad claims with a few specifics, leaving important claims under-evidenced."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Backs most major claims with concrete examples, mechanisms, or outcomes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is densely specific enough that the reader can clearly picture what the applicant built and why it mattered."}]},{"evidence":"recurrent misspellings and occasional fragments","name":"Mechanical polish","description":"This captures the degree to which spelling, grammar, and sentence construction help or hurt the letter's professionalism.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent errors or broken constructions that noticeably damage clarity or credibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains multiple visible errors but remains readable overall."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Contains only minor or infrequent mechanical issues."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Reads as clean, careful, and professionally polished."}]},{"evidence":"software that guards other software must be built to a higher standard","name":"Voice","description":"This captures whether the letter has a distinctive professional voice and memorable framing rather than sounding purely formulaic.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as flat, compliance-style prose with little individuality."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Reads as competent but familiar and interchangeable with many other applications."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a clear personal voice or a strong framing device that adds interest."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Sustains a memorable, controlled voice that makes the letter stand out beyond its credential list."}]}]}
